page.overview:
Who is Everard?

Professor Everard was one of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry's most celebrated Heads. His portrait hangs in the headmaster's office and in the Ministry of Magic's headquarters.

Everard was made Headmaster of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in an unknown time period.

After his death, he was remembered as one of the most celebrated Heads of Hogwarts.

When Arthur Weasley was attacked by Nagini in the Department of Mysteries in late 1995, Albus Dumbledore, then Headmaster, asked Everard to go to his portrait at the Ministry of Magic's Headquarters in order to warn others that Mr Weasley was injured at the Department.
